daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Volatility Rankings with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, calculate the 20-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns for each stock. Use window functions (PARTITION BY ticker, ORDER BY date) to rank stocks by volatility within each month. Return the top 5 most volatile stocks per month, including ticker, date, closing price, rolling volatility, and volatility rank. Use a CTE to first calculate daily percentage returns, then another CTE for the rolling standard deviation.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data (contains crash records with location, severity, vehicle type, weather conditions). Clean the dataset by: (1) handling missing values in severity and weather columns (impute with mode or drop as appropriate), (2) standardising location strings to title case, (3) converting date columns to datetime format, (4) creating new features: crash_hour from timestamp, severity_category (binning injury counts), and weather_risk_score. Output a cleaned CSV with 10+ columns ready for analysis. Document your data quality assumptions in comments.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wildfire Impact Analysis Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build a data pipeline combining Python and SQL: (1) In Python, download Australian Wildfire dataset (Kaggle), clean fire duration data, convert hectares burned to standardised numeric format, and filter for fires in 2020-2024. Export to CSV. (2) In SQL, load the cleaned data, calculate cumulative hectares burned by state using window functions (SUM() OVER PARTITION BY state ORDER BY date), identify the fire season (months with peak activity) for each state, and rank states by total area burned across the period. Return a summary table: state, fire_season_months, total_hectares_burned, rank. Use CTEs to structure your query clearly.
